## ✨ Feature Description

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see in BaatCheet.

---

## 🎯 Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

Explain why this feature would be useful to BaatCheet users.

---

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature could work.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you considered.

---

## 🎨 UI / UX

If this feature involves changes to the user interface, describe how you imagine it working.

You may also attach:

- Screenshots
- Wireframes
- Mockups
- Reference designs

---

## 🧩 Affected Area

- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] User Management
- [ ] Chat
- [ ] Real-Time Messaging
- [ ] Socket.IO
- [ ] Image Upload
- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend
- [ ] Database
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

---

## 📋 Additional Information

Add any other information, examples, references, or ideas that may help explain the feature.

---

## 🔍 Before Submitting

- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate.
- [ ] This feature is relevant to BaatCheet.
- [ ] I have clearly explained the problem and proposed solution.
